_comment: Runtime config for the Austin Beefs cycle. Change cadence_days to change how often it posts - that's the only knob you need.
_cadence_note: Post one card every N days. Set to 2 for every-other-day, 3 for every third day, etc. The workflow runs DAILY but exits early unless it's been >= cadence_days since the last post (see .github/workflows/cycle.yml). This beats a raw cron interval because 'every 3 days' via cron drifts across month boundaries; the day-gate does not.
_time_note: The cron fires once daily; the deadline shown on cards is computed as publish_time + cadence_days (guardrail G3). Voting window == the gap between posts.
_gate_note: auto_publish:false = the review gate. While false, the cycle opens a PR with the next card+caption instead of posting. Flip to true after the ~2-week review phase (see BUILD.md step 8).
_verdict_gate_note: Keep a human eye on the tally->verdict step LONGER than the rest (a miscounted winner erodes trust). When auto_publish flips true, consider keeping verdict cards PR-gated a while longer by leaving this true and having the cycle prompt still open a PR for verdict-type posts only.
